correctness.rationale: Identified all S3 permutations with affine maps on F3 and reconstructed each of the four sign-dependent translation coefficients. Their complete evaluation data is exactly (N0 mod 6, three alternating sums mod 3), with no omitted sign/parity case. Verified all 162 possible signatures, the exact recursive image at each length 0–13, and a 162-witness coverage certificate at length 13. Independently evaluated every one of the 16383 binary words of lengths 0–13 under 36 ordered S3 substitution pairs. The two append-transition maps are bijections on the whole 162-state space, proving the infinite tail rather than extrapolating from finite experiments. Conditions: binary equal-length words, permutation actions, any initial state/accept subset.

value.rationale: Determines the complete size profile of a canonical equal-length word-equivalence quotient for all binary words under S3 substitutions, exactly classifies behavior by four residues, identifies sharp first saturation, and provides shortest-length representatives for all 162 types. This fills a motivated length-resolved question in permutation automata and positive identities, rather than a normalized reformulation or arbitrary small parameter table. Extends a finite certificate to every length using a structural bijection lemma; does not claim improved asymptotic state-separation bounds.
